engineSideBuildDone.deviationFromDispatchLiteralText: The dispatch's one-sentence description ('a rail NOT in that set with zero earned cells in this county is a REFUSAL') would, read literally, ALSO refuse a county that is genuinely, entirely not-applicable for a rail (e.g. a fully unincorporated county's zoningDistrict cells) whenever that rail happens to be live elsewhere in the program -- because not-applicable cells are not 'earned' either. This would have broken an existing, deliberately-written engine test (__tests__/rail-gate.test.ts, 'not-applicable cells are neither earned nor unaccounted...') that asserts a fully not-applicable county must stay excluded, never refuse. Quoted per DEV_PROCESS 3.2a rather than silently deviating: the fix adds one exemption -- when EVERY cell for a rail in this county is not-applicable (never true for an empty cell set, which is handled separately), it stays excluded regardless of the rail's program-wide status. A MIX of not-applicable and unaccounted cells (not ALL not-applicable) does NOT qualify for the exemption and refuses normally -- covered by a new test.
